rows.note: Use this as the usual direct term for a person who shares your room, especially in a dormitory or shared apartment.

example.english: I live with my roommate in the dorm.
example.traditional: 我喺宿舍同室友一齊住。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 suk1 se3 tung4 sat1 jau5 jat1 cai4 zyu6

rows.note: Use this for someone in the same room when the shared-room setting is clear, such as a dormitory or hospital ward.

example.english: When I was in the hospital, my roommate was very easy to talk to.
example.traditional: 我入院嗰陣，同房係個好好傾嘅人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jap6 jyun2 go2 zan6 tung4 fong2 hai6 go3 hou2 hou2 king1 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a non-family housemate who shares your home but not necessarily your room.

example.english: My roommate often cooks for me.
example.traditional: 我個同屋成日煮飯畀我食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 tung4 uk1 seng4 jat6 zyu2 faan6 bei2 ngo5 sik6
